description: Distribution divergence before and after BDCL calibration, averaged across the 10-question evaluation instrument
finding: BDCL contributes a 78% reduction in JS divergence. Post-calibration per-category deviations (0.3 pp) sit an order of magnitude below the benchmark's own sampling uncertainty (±3.2 pp), so the calibrated distribution is statistically indistinguishable from the target population distribution at the resolution the benchmark affords.
